description: A female character with teal hair and glowing cybernetic armor floats dynamically in a destroyed sci-fi battlefield, wielding a large glowing staff. In the background, a smaller winged figure flies through floating debris and holographic data streams under a dramatic cloudy sky.
title: Cyber Sorceress in Void
prompt: A dynamic full-body shot of a beautiful female cyber sorceress with flowing teal hair and golden mechanical crown, wearing sleek dark metallic bodysuit with glowing cyan and orange accents, floating mid-air with one leg bent. She holds a massive futuristic staff with glowing cyan runes and golden details in her right hand, left hand extended with energy. Her back features large translucent teal energy wings. The background is a destroyed sci-fi battlefield filled with floating asteroids, wreckage, holographic blue data streams, and a smaller winged armored figure flying in the distance. Cinematic lighting, dramatic rim light, volumetric atmosphere, detailed mechanical textures, glowing effects, in the style of League of Legends concept art
